summary: Verified Términos y Condiciones + Política de Privacidad per Chile/Spain law. Backend 15/15 pytest cases pass (added test_checkout_rejects_without_accept_terms; patched existing checkout tests to send accept_terms:true; verified user.terms_accepted_at is persisted). Frontend: footer-terms-link and footer-privacy-link render on landing and navigate to /terminos (legal-page-terminos) and /privacidad (legal-page-privacidad) with legal-title visible; legal-back-link returns to /; mobile 390px renders legal page correctly. Enroll dialog: enroll-accept-terms checkbox present; enroll-submit stays disabled until form is filled AND checkbox is checked; after check, submit enables and free-course enrollment flows to /pago/resultado with status '¡Inscripción confirmada!'. Regression: landing-partners still shows 5 logos (AWS, Tramilex, GoRoky, Openfactura, Inmo Tramilex).

issues: Contact email intentional placeholder '[correo de contacto]' remains visible in body text; main agent should replace with real email before go-live.

action_items: Replace placeholder '[correo de contacto]' in Legal.jsx with real contact email before launch.
Consider adding DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the enroll dialog (carry-over from iteration_6).
critical_code_review_comments: shop.py CheckoutIn.accept_terms defaults to False and server raises 400 before any user/payment creation if missing/false — correct ordering, no side effects on refusal.
terms_accepted_at timestamp is written AFTER the acceptance check and only on successful branch (good).
Legal.jsx is static and self-contained; TERMS/PRIVACY arrays hard-coded in JSX — if content changes frequently, consider moving to a CMS/collection, but acceptable for current MVP.
The enrollment checkbox uses both HTML `required` and `disabled` on submit — defensive and correct.
Footer links use react-router <Link>, so legal pages load without full reload (good).

Test fixture seed_test_data auto-creates test-admin-1 user, test-c1 (49900 paid, show_on_landing), test-c2 (free, show_on_landing), and fake Flow keys (FAKE-KEY/fakesecret123) during pytest module scope and cleans up after.
